services:
  zero9repo:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: zero9repo-manager
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    environment:
      - HOST=0.0.0.0
      - PORT=8000
      - SECRET_KEY=zero9repo-production-key-change-me-2026
      - DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:////app/data/zero9repo.db
      - ADMIN_USERNAME=admin
      - ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin123
      - ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@zero9repo.io
    volumes:
      - zero9repo_data:/app/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8000/api/stats/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

volumes:
  zero9repo_data:
    driver: local
